archetype: Contextual (Epic: Luxury/Fantasy, Hype: Electric/Swiss, Chill: Pastel/Soft)
global_instructions: Build a single React component EpicInvitePanel.jsx that changes completely based on the 'tone' prop (epic | hype | chill). Do not reuse the same layout containers. Instead, conditionally render completely different UI structures for each tone to ensure they feel like distinct worlds. Add Google Fonts via an injected <style> tag at the top of the component. Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements.

implementation_rules_for_main_agent: 2. Use standard React with Tailwind utilities. Import the Google fonts exactly as provided in the instructions using an injected <style> block, like: <style>{`@import url(...)`}</style>

3. Destructure these exact props: { tone = 'epic', inviterName = 'Admin', householdName = 'The Citadel', questHook = { headline: 'A NEW QUEST AWAITS', body: 'Join us to conquer the chores and claim glory.' }, note = 'Hope you can join our realm!', inviteCode = 'BATTLE-READY', valueBullets = ['Gamified chores', 'Epic rewards', 'Fair distribution', 'Secret missions'], onRerollHook, onChangeTone }
4. Add a `data-testid` attribute to all interactive elements, e.g., data-testid='copy-code-button'.

5. Conditionally render the entire wrapper and its children based on the `tone` prop. Do not try to merge them into a single convoluted template string. Create three distinct JSX blocks: if (tone === 'epic') return <EpicVariant />; etc, or keep them in the same file as separate components.

6. Do not use generic Shadcn cards for this specific component—this is the 'Artifact', so it must be built entirely from primitive divs and Tailwind classes exactly as specified in the `styles` mappings above.
7. Add an interactive 'Copy' feature using navigator.clipboard for the invite code. When clicked, temporarily change the text of the button or show a brief 'Copied!' toast/state.

8. Add an admin control block at the top right of the component (outside the main poster, or as a floating badge) that allows changing the tone or rerolling the hook if `onChangeTone` and `onRerollHook` are provided.
9. For the Epic tone, ensure the bullet icon is '◆'. For Hype, use '[×]'. For Chill, use '✨'.
